gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-nata-sans: Woodgod's lowercase climbs almost to the capitals, with a generous channel cut into every bowl. Nata Sans takes over below with a large central band and curves that stay open, drawn with a technical pen's steadiness.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its x-height close to its caps, with letter mouths left open like an unjoined chalk arc. Nobile is the quiet, sans-serif partner here, while Woodgod's vintage, commanding display letters carry the loud part.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-nokora: Woodgod announces itself with a vintage, commanding voice and lowercase that nearly touches the capitals. Nokora then fills each line with a thick, dark stripe of text, its s never tightening, so paragraphs read friendly and steady.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, plus a wide channel into every bowl, gives Woodgod its vintage swagger. Noto Kufi Arabic, a modern sans-serif, does the opposite job: capitals barely above lowercase and a welcoming gap in the c.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans: Commanding and a bit vintage, Woodgod pushes its lowercase almost to cap height and opens a wide channel into each bowl. Noto Sans, a plain sans, fills in beneath it.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-adlam:
Woodgod's lowercase nearly matches its capitals in height.

Beneath it, Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and lets c, s and z stand tall and full, so the vintage display letters get a clean, contemporary companion.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Vintage muscle, then breathing room. Woodgod's wide-channeled bowls sit above Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, a plain sans with generous space between curve ends and stems and barely any height gap between cases.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: Woodgod brings a commanding, vintage look, with a wide channel into every bowl and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. And Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs, a modern sans-serif, matches that height with outward-pointing terminals.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Woodgod's tall lowercase, which nearly reaches its capitals, and wide-channeled bowls give it a vintage, commanding face. Noto Sans Arabic, a plain sans, is the one with the pronounced x-height and wide openings on small letters.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-armenian:
Woodgod cuts a wide channel into every bowl.

Noto Sans Armenian answers with tall, full c, s and z and inviting round openings, and that approachable, professional warmth is what makes the vintage heading easy to live beside.
